intermediates.name: average_daily_demand
intermediates.label: Average daily demand
intermediates.description: The central estimate the whole calculation is built on.

intermediates.name: demand_std_dev
intermediates.label: Daily demand variability (σd)
intermediates.formula: standard deviation from observed history (180 days)
intermediates.description: How much a typical day departs from the average. Drives the buffer size.

intermediates.name: service_level_z
intermediates.label: Service-level factor (z)
intermediates.description: Covering 95.0% of outcomes needs 1.645 standard deviations of buffer.

intermediates.name: protection_period
intermediates.label: Protection period
intermediates.description: The window stock must survive alone: until the order lands, plus the wait for the next chance to order.

intermediates.name: demand_variance_component
intermediates.label: Variance from demand
intermediates.description: Risk contributed by demand moving around during the protection period.

intermediates.name: lead_time_variance_component
intermediates.label: Variance from lead time
intermediates.description: Risk contributed by the supplier being late. Zero when lead time is treated as fixed.

intermediates.name: combined_sigma
intermediates.label: Combined variability (σ)
intermediates.description: Total uncertainty over the protection period. Variances add; standard deviations do not, which is why they are combined under one root.

intermediates.name: safety_stock
intermediates.label: Safety stock
intermediates.description: Buffer held purely against variability, above expected demand.

intermediates.name: cycle_demand
intermediates.label: Expected demand in the protection period
intermediates.description: What will probably sell before the replenishment arrives.

intermediates.name: reorder_point
intermediates.label: Reorder point
intermediates.description: Order when inventory position falls to this level.

intermediates.name: inventory_position
intermediates.label: Inventory position
intermediates.description: Compared against the reorder point. On-order units count, or every review would re-order stock already in transit.

intermediates.name: economic_order_quantity
intermediates.label: Economic order quantity
intermediates.formula: √(2 × annual demand × ordering cost ÷ holding cost)
intermediates.description: The order size that minimises ordering plus holding cost, before shortfall and pack-size adjustments.

intermediates.name: recommended_order_quantity
intermediates.label: Recommended order quantity
intermediates.formula: 0 when above the reorder point; otherwise max(EOQ, shortfall) raised to the minimum order quantity and rounded up to the pack multiple

method_note: EOQ from annual demand 42928, ordering cost 75/order, holding cost 3/unit/year
